title: Research

title: Viktor Jahnke
text:
Theoretical physicist working at the interface between quantum chaos and the AdS/CFT correspondence.
I am a researcher at IFT-UNESP in São Paulo, Brazil.
My research focuses on universal aspects of quantum dynamics and quantum gravity, combining ideas from holography, quantum information, and random matrix theory.

title: Viktor Jahnke
text:
Research interests

Quantum chaos, thermalization, and ETH
Holography, AdS/CFT, and black-hole dynamics
OTOCs and quantum information scrambling
Random matrix theory and free probability
Krylov complexity and operator growth
